value: Headline end HP (gauntlet_protocol.end_hp, boss-floor HP on a clear) pays 1:1 for HP left after the Act 1 boss, which the game heals to full at A0 and 75% of missing at A5+ (worth 0 at A0, ~0.25/point at A20). Recent leads were mostly that: all-content twin +1.41 = +0.09 clear flips + 1.32 shared; a real effect splits (two turns over one +6.14 = 3.68 flips + 2.45). A20 reads report V (backlog 90).
